notes: Full description: DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains stores a String substring. In DeviationScope::matches (pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:274-278), every call does substring.to_lowercase() on each invocation, allocating a new String every time matches() is called. For a deviation store consulted once per certificate per lint, this is O(findings * deviations) allocations. Fix: normalize the substring to lowercase at construction time (in DeviationStore::add or in an IssuerDnContains constructor). The stored string should already be lowercased. The comparison becomes: issuer_str.to_lowercase().contains(self.0.as_str()) where self.0 is already lowercase. This eliminates the per-call allocation of the lowercased substring. The to_string() + to_lowercase() on the issuer side is still needed since the cert's issuer is not pre-lowercased, but the substring side is caller-controlled.
title: RUSTY: IssuerDnContains repeats to_lowercase on hot path
